name: session-harness
description: The interactive coding harness: one task = one isolated clone + one attended Claude session, plans and code hardened adversarially by the COMPLEMENTARY tool (Claude authors → Codex critiques), and a human merging every PR. Ships four slash commands — /isession (provision an isolated clone and open a session rooted in it), /iharden (file the plan as an issue and loop it against an independent Codex critic to convergence), /iship (implement under a completion bar: simplify pass → green-light → draft PR → adversarial review loop → AC checklist → ready for a human to merge), /reap (recycle merged sessions into warm idle clones) — plus two skills: adversarial-review, the review turn harness that converges by SEVERITY rather than zero-findings and offers an advisory DeepSeek third opinion and a directed --ask probe, and harness-setup, which wires the flow into a repo you already have. Every unattended model call runs under a supervisor that bounds it, isolates each attempt's output, and retries only where a read-only sandbox makes a second run free.
